product: Search and replace text across files
tagline: You can now search and replace text across files in a Databricks Git folder or Declarative Automation Bundles project from the Search pane.
what_it_does: You can now search and replace text across files in a Databricks Git folder or Declarative Automation Bundles project from the Search pane. The Databricks notebook and file editor provides keyboard shortcuts, code suggestions and autocomplete, variable inspection, and code folding to help you write and navigate code. When you use the notebook or the file editor, Genie Code is available to help you generate, explain, and debug code.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: You can now search and replace text across files in a Databricks Git folder or Declarative Automation Bundles project from the Search pane.
